name: Meghmani Organics Limited
summary: Meghmani Organics Limited produces pigments and agrochemicals for India and global markets. Its green and blue pigments go into printing inks, paints, coatings and plastics, while its agrochemicals include insecticides like cypermethrin, chlorpyriphos and fipronil and herbicides such as triclopyr. Ahmedabad is its headquarters, and it dates from 1986.
